NIKAH & VALIMA SAME DAY 7538 views Q. Nikah 2020 views Q. Walimah 3012 views Q. I am madly in love with one of my relatives. She is also madly in love with me. We want to marry each other. but her parents arranged her marraige somewhere else saying that love before marraige is immoral in islam. Is it correct that love for somebody before marraige is haram in islam. can we get married. 5665 views Q. Please tell me the best (sunnah) way to keep my nikah and walimah in today's time to achieve maximum barakah and similarity to the nikah and walimah of the Prophet (PBUH) 8683 views Q. my question is that is it possible to marry a girl without changing her religion to islam if she is ahle qitab i.e. she already belong to the religion in which allah's books revealed(injeel, taurat & zaboor) 2745 views Q. Dear Mufti sahib, i have a question that my parents decided to marry me with a girl which was among our relatives. due to some reason our engagement delayed but we started talking on phone and now we are in love with each other. i am 26 and she is 29. now the situation is this that her parents refuse to marry her with me due to the love realtion we build up. as it was decided between our parents and now we cant live without each other. my parents are also forcing me to leave her but i cannot do this as we have accepted each other as husband and wife and we have a very strong bond between both of us. now the question is can i marry her without the approval of my parents because both side parents are not agreed now due to EGO problem. i also dont want to hurt my parents but its a matter of my life now and i have to make a decision. so please advice me what should i do..?? both of us are financially strong,she is a doctor and im a software engineer. 3300 views Q. Regarding validity for marriage 2470 views Q. I want to get married to a christian girl who is a divorcee and is 3 yrs elder to me. I have been dating her since last two years and finally decided to get married. She is ready to convert to Islam just to marry me. Can you pls. help me know the procedure of converting to Islam and how to influence her belief and faith in Islam. Allah maaf kare but we dont follow a proper Islam in terms of Namaz, Roza and involed in other sinful activities. Request you to pray for me, May Allah bless me with a true Islam. 2) Christians are termed as ahle kitaab. so can we marry them without converting? 3) I had lived with this girl for last 2 yrs and have been involve in sinful activities. After her conversion her sins would be washed off as said in religious book, then what about me? 4) how can i correct myself. 4595 views Q. illegal relationship 4981 views Q. Nikah 2072 views
